lines: Three workstreams built one feature from one sentence.
Thirty tests pass. All three are green.
Integration still finds two conflicts.
captions: Three workstreams built one feature from one sentence.
Thirty tests pass. All three are green.
Integration still finds two conflicts.

lines: Each workstream was locally right.
API keys the customer by email. Ledger uses account_id. Notifications never touches it.
COLLIDER checks each collision against the source.
Where the brief already decided, it is agent drift. Where the brief is silent, it is a spec gap.
captions: Each workstream was locally right.
API keys the customer by email. Ledger uses account_id. Notifications never touches it.
COLLIDER checks each collision against the source.
Where the brief already decided: AGENT_DRIFT. Where the brief is silent: SPEC_GAP.

lines: The brief names refund_amount, so Ledger is repaired from source.
It never names a customer identity. So COLLIDER stops at UNKNOWN, and asks one question.
Keeping UNKNOWN is a valid answer. Here, we choose account_id.
captions: The brief names refund_amount, so Ledger is repaired from source.
It never names a customer identity. So COLLIDER stops at UNKNOWN, and asks one question.
Keeping UNKNOWN is a valid answer. Here, we choose account_id.

lines: That answer compiles.
The spec is patched, API and Ledger are repaired, a regression contract is written, and the decision is stored as memory.
Two conflicts become zero.
captions: That answer compiles.
The spec is patched, API and Ledger are repaired, a regression contract is written, and the decision is stored as memory.
Two conflicts become zero.

lines: Now a future change puts email back. Tests fail, and decision memory blocks the merge.
captions: A future change puts email back. Tests fail, and decision memory blocks the merge: MERGE_BLOCKED.

lines: A wording change to the customer notice touches no decision. Merge allowed.
captions: A wording change to the customer notice touches no decision: MERGE_ALLOWED.

lines: Then Ledger switches to dollars. All thirty seven tests pass.
COLLIDER still returns decision required, because nobody ever decided the money unit.
captions: Then Ledger switches to dollars. All 37 tests pass.
COLLIDER still returns DECISION_REQUIRED, because nobody ever decided the money unit.

lines: The demo data is preseeded, and labelled that way.
Separately, IBM Bob ran the protocol live, with three independent agents.
The first replay passed five of seven checks, and we kept that failure. A targeted replay passed seven of seven.

lines: COLLIDER is semantic CI for AI agents.
When agents disagree, it finds the decision the specification forgot to make.
